candidate_pool_assembly.preferred_categories: Sampled using Pareto power-law x^2.2 from items sorted by (0.6*sold + 0.4*rating) desc (up to 12 items/cat)
candidate_pool_assembly.preferred_brands: Sampled using Pareto power-law x^2.0 from items sorted by (0.6*sold + 0.4*rating) desc (up to 10 items/brand)
candidate_pool_assembly.global_popular: 10 items uniformly sampled from global top 100 popular items
candidate_pool_assembly.catalog_exploration: 6 items uniformly sampled from full catalog

equation.affinity_formula: If exploration (p = exploration_tendency): score = 0.20 + U(0, 0.30). Else: score = max(0.02, 0.05 [base] + 0.40 * I(cat in preferred) + 0.35 * I(brand in preferred) + budget_bonus + popularity_bias * (0.6 * min(1, sold/1000) + 0.4 * max(0, (rating-3)/2)) + U(-0.08, 0.08))
equation.top_pool_selection: Candidates sorted by affinity descending; top 16 items form topPool.
equation.event_item_selection: If repeat_purchase (p = repeat_purchase_tendency) and past items exist: choose from history. Else: choose uniformly from topPool.

preferred_categories.mechanism: Pareto power-law pool injection + 0.40 affinity bonus

preferred_brands.mechanism: Pareto power-law pool injection + 0.35 affinity bonus

price_min_max.mechanism: 0.20 affinity bonus if within bounds, 0.08 if soft match

exploration_tendency.mechanism: Probability of bypassing preference scoring to assign uniform noise score

popularity_bias.mechanism: Weights product normalized sold count (0.6) and rating (0.4)

repeat_purchase_tendency.mechanism: Probability of re-sampling an item already interacted with

latent_factors.status: User latent_factors are generated/stored but do not influence item selection.

critical_findings.statement: User latent_factors are generated/stored but do not influence item selection.
critical_findings.explanation: Products in the production catalog have observable metadata (category, brand, price, sales, rating) but have NO planted latent vector q_i. While user profiles store a 5-dimensional vector latent_factors, this vector is never referenced in computeAffinity() or candidate sampling. Therefore, in scenario cf_experiment_v1, there is NO planted collaborative latent interaction for Funk MF or Item-kNN to discover beyond observable content affinity and popularity.
